review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Preserve manual compaction while fencing actual rearm decisions
review.notes: Self-review found b530 fences PostCompact before checking whether its trigger actually rearms. A manual compact is state-neutral but must still record its real lifecycle receipt. This addendum preserves original CET expectations and adds a real Run regression. Design is sealed/committed before editing the existing new test source; exact b530 old failure and new green will be recorded. Source review of b530 remains accurate to that Q, not extended to this necessary delta. Exact history check rejected assigning CET-006 to a file first created for CET-004/005 earlier in this same PR. Preserve all commits and true chronology: review the move of this unchanged manual case to its own new file before creating that file. Original test file retains only its original mappings; no checker relaxation or history rewrite.

cases.description: Manual PostCompact after a completed explicit turn remains observable without reactivating work.
cases.setup: Use the existing hermetic Codex frontend fixture and production Run. Submit and complete a synthetic turn; no real pane, native compact or service.
cases.action: Invoke PostCompact with trigger=manual and the same completed turn ID; compare actual event journal, active/turn/finished markers before and after. Existing automatic/unknown rearm fences still run.
cases.expected: A real manual PostCompact receipt is recorded once, active stays absent and exact completion/current turn remain intact. Only actual rearm decisions are eligible for the completed-turn fence.
